The test image shows two bell pepper fruits with large, dark brown-to-black, sunken lesions displaying clear **concentric ring patterns**. No mycelial growth is visible (ruling out Gray Mold, Rhizopus, Sclerotinia, Southern Blight). The Anthracnose reference showed the identical symptom type on a pepper fruit, just at an earlier stage. The KB description matches perfectly: "circular, water-soaked and sunken spots... form concentric rings, expand, darken progressively, and may merge to cause complete fruit decay."
